typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFilePath as string (),
	AuthFileName as string (),
	AuthOBFileName as string (),
	AuthRecCount as integer (),
	AuthTermFileName as string (),
	AuthTermRecCount as integer (),
	ConfFileName as string (),
	ConfOBFileName as string (),
	ConfOBQuery as string (),
	ConfRecCount as integer (),
	ConfTermFileName as string (),
	ConfTermRecCount as integer (),
	InboundFileLocation as string (),
	PWD as string (),
	ResRecCount as integer (),
	ResTermRecCount as integer (),
	RestFileName as string (),
	RestOBFileName as string (),
	RestOBQuery as string (),
	RestTermFileName as string (),
	RUNID as string (),
	Server as string (),
	ToFolder as string (),
	UserName as string ()
}

source(output(
		N_FIRST as string,
		N_MID_INIT as string,
		N_LAST as string,
		N_SUFFIX as string,
		I_SSN as string,
		D_DOB as string,
		C_HIPAA_GENDER as string,
		F_EMPLOYEE as string,
		C_PREFIX as string,
		I_CONTRACT as string,
		I_HCID as string,
		C_INDIV_REL as string,
		C_ANT_ENT as string,
		End as string,
		N_FIRST_P as string,
		N_MID_INIT_P as string,
		N_LAST_P as string,
		N_SUFFIX_P as string,
		F_HONOR_RESTRICT as string,
		C_RESTRICTION as string,
		N_FIRST_RESTRICT as string,
		N_LAST_RESTRICT as string,
		D_COMPLETED as string,
		N_FIRST_COMPLETED as string,
		N_LAST_COMPLETED as string,
		C_NOTIFY_METH as string,
		D_NOTIFIED as string,
		N_FIRST_NOTIFIED as string,
		N_LAST_NOTIFIED as string,
		D_EFFECT_RESTRICT as string,
		D_CANCEL_RESTRICT as string,
		T_RESTRICT_DESCRIP as string,
		C_REQUEST_REL as string,
		C_REQUESTOR_TYPE as string,
		C_REQUEST_METHOD as string,
		D_RECEIVED as string,
		FILLER as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(RunID = toDouble(RUNID),
		FileType = toString(trim('REST')),
		D_DOB = iif(isNull(D_DOB) || length(trim(D_DOB)) == 0, toTimestamp(toString('1900-01-01', 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), toTimestamp(toString((substring(toString(D_DOB), toInteger(1), toInteger(4)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_DOB), toInteger(5), toInteger(2)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_DOB), toInteger(7), toInteger(2))), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy')),
		D_COMPLETED = iif(isNull(D_COMPLETED) || length(trim(D_COMPLETED)) == 0, toTimestamp(toString('1900-01-01', 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), toTimestamp(toString((substring(toString(D_COMPLETED), toInteger(1), toInteger(4)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_COMPLETED), toInteger(5), toInteger(2)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_COMPLETED), toInteger(7), toInteger(2))), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy')),
		D_NOTIFIED = iif(isNull(D_NOTIFIED) || length(trim(D_NOTIFIED)) == 0, toTimestamp(toString('1900-01-01', 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), toTimestamp(toString((substring(toString(D_NOTIFIED), toInteger(1), toInteger(4)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_NOTIFIED), toInteger(5), toInteger(2)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_NOTIFIED), toInteger(7), toInteger(2))), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy')),
		D_EFFECT_RESTRICT = iif(isNull(D_EFFECT_RESTRICT) || length(trim(D_EFFECT_RESTRICT)) == 0, toTimestamp(toString('1900-01-01', 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), toTimestamp(toString((substring(toString(D_EFFECT_RESTRICT), toInteger(1), toInteger(4)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_EFFECT_RESTRICT), toInteger(5), toInteger(2)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_EFFECT_RESTRICT), toInteger(7), toInteger(2))), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy')),
		D_CANCEL_RESTRICT = iif(isNull(D_CANCEL_RESTRICT) || length(trim(D_CANCEL_RESTRICT)) == 0, toTimestamp(toString('1900-01-01', 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), toTimestamp(toString((substring(toString(D_CANCEL_RESTRICT), toInteger(1), toInteger(4)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_CANCEL_RESTRICT), toInteger(5), toInteger(2)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_CANCEL_RESTRICT), toInteger(7), toInteger(2))), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy')),
		D_RECEIVED = iif(isNull(D_RECEIVED) || length(trim(D_RECEIVED)) == 0, toTimestamp(toString('1900-01-01', 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), toTimestamp(toString((substring(toString(D_RECEIVED), toInteger(1), toInteger(4)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_RECEIVED), toInteger(5), toInteger(2)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_RECEIVED), toInteger(7), toInteger(2))), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy'))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive(D_CANCEL_RESTRICT = toTimestamp(toString(iif((greaterOrEqual(D_CANCEL_RESTRICT,toTimestamp(toString('2099-12-31', 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy'))), toDate(toString('2099-12-31', 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"), toDate(toString(D_CANCEL_RESTRICT, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy")), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy')) ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn1 sink(input(
		D_CANCEL_RESTRICT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		RunID as double,
		FileType as string,
		D_DOB as timestamp 'ect.format.datetime.hypen.4year2month2day2hour24mmnute2secondsdot6nanoseconds',
		D_COMPLETED as timestamp 'ect.format.datetime.hypen.4year2month2day2hour24mmnute2secondsdot6nanoseconds',
		D_NOTIFIED as timestamp 'ect.format.datetime.hypen.4year2month2day2hour24mmnute2secondsdot6nanoseconds',
		D_EFFECT_RESTRICT as timestamp 'ect.format.datetime.hypen.4year2month2day2hour24mmnute2secondsdot6nanoseconds',
		D_RECEIVED as timestamp 'ect.format.datetime.hypen.4year2month2day2hour24mmnute2secondsdot6nanoseconds',
		N_FIRST as string,
		N_MID_INIT as string,
		N_LAST as string,
		N_SUFFIX as string,
		I_SSN as string,
		C_HIPAA_GENDER as string,
		F_EMPLOYEE as string,
		C_PREFIX as string,
		I_CONTRACT as string,
		I_HCID as string,
		C_INDIV_REL as string,
		C_ANT_ENT as string,
		End as string,
		N_FIRST_P as string,
		N_MID_INIT_P as string,
		N_LAST_P as string,
		N_SUFFIX_P as string,
		F_HONOR_RESTRICT as string,
		C_RESTRICTION as string,
		N_FIRST_RESTRICT as string,
		N_LAST_RESTRICT as string,
		N_FIRST_COMPLETED as string,
		N_LAST_COMPLETED as string,
		C_NOTIFY_METH as string,
		N_FIRST_NOTIFIED as string,
		N_LAST_NOTIFIED as string,
		T_RESTRICT_DESCRIP as string,
		C_REQUEST_REL as string,
		C_REQUESTOR_TYPE as string,
		C_REQUEST_METHOD as string,
		FILLER as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		D_CANCEL_RESTRICT,
		RunID,
		FileType,
		D_DOB,
		D_COMPLETED,
		D_NOTIFIED,
		D_EFFECT_RESTRICT,
		D_RECEIVED,
		N_FIRST,
		N_MID_INIT,
		N_LAST,
		N_SUFFIX,
		I_SSN,
		C_HIPAA_GENDER,
		F_EMPLOYEE,
		C_PREFIX,
		I_CONTRACT,
		I_HCID,
		C_INDIV_REL,
		C_ANT_ENT,
		End,
		N_FIRST_P,
		N_MID_INIT_P,
		N_LAST_P,
		N_SUFFIX_P,
		F_HONOR_RESTRICT,
		C_RESTRICTION,
		N_FIRST_RESTRICT,
		N_LAST_RESTRICT,
		N_FIRST_COMPLETED,
		N_LAST_COMPLETED,
		C_NOTIFY_METH,
		N_FIRST_NOTIFIED,
		N_LAST_NOTIFIED,
		T_RESTRICT_DESCRIP,
		C_REQUEST_REL,
		C_REQUESTOR_TYPE,
		C_REQUEST_METHOD,
		FILLER)) ~> OutputPlaceHolderOracleDestination
